title: process.binding is deprecated
summary: Node.js documents process.binding() as for internal use only and deprecates it (DEP0111, documentation-only since v10.9.0); it is unavailable when the permission model is enabled.
replacement: The public API that replaces the binding in use; the entry names no single replacement

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace process.binding
steps.instructions: Identify which internal binding is requested and move to its public module, for example util.types.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
